THE GAME

Co-op · Party · Arcade

Trash Party is an online co-op party game for up to 4 players. One garbage truck, one city covered in junk, and a crew that has to work together before the clock runs out.

Every level is a route through the neighborhood. The truck rolls from stop to stop, and the crew has to clear each block before it's time to move on. Anyone can take the wheel, so decide who drives, who throws and who chases the dog that just ran off with a bag.

Sort every bag into the right bin, team up on the heavy stuff and cash in at the lever. Earn stars on each route to open new parts of the city on the map.

WHAT'S INSIDE

01

Sort it right

Recyclable, organic and glass each have their own bin on the truck. Toss a bag into the matching color and it counts. Get it wrong and the truck spits it right back.

02

Lift with your legs

Sofas and other bulky junk need both hands. Carry them alone if you must, or grab a friend and haul them together. Drop them behind the truck and the press turns them into neat bales.

03

Everyone drives

There's one truck and anyone can take the wheel. Ride on the back, jump off at the next stop and keep the route moving.

04

The street fights back

Traffic doesn't stop for garbage collectors, a stray dog loves to steal bags, and your crew can always slap you back to work.

05

Make them yours

Dress up your collector with new outfits and ridiculous heads, from a trash can to a TV.

06

Trained by the Boss

Thirty years hauling trash and he never left a single bag behind. The Boss teaches the rookies everything, whether they like it or not.
